tool.name: Order upload input check (synthetic)
tool.purpose: Identify missing fields in a synthetic order-upload sample before a manual route investigation.

fields.name: shipping_condition
fields.meaning: Upload-level value to inspect if the interface supports it.

fields.name: departure_country
fields.meaning: Departure context supplied by the synthetic test fixture.

fields.name: departure_zone
fields.meaning: Departure zone supplied by the synthetic test fixture.

tool.result: A list of missing or empty fields, not an SAP determination outcome.
limitations: Demonstration only: no SAP connection, customizing read, or transaction update.
This is not a complete SAP standard route-determination input model.
A complete set of sample values does not prove that an SAP route can be determined.
tool.owner: DKHARLANAU Labs sample; review business assumptions before reuse
